turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model log[y] = b1 - b2*x1 * exp[-b3*x2] to the data in nelson.csv (columns x1, x2, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 2, b2 = 0.0001, b3 = -0.01. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Nelson (public domain), data copied verbatim
